segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I saw your note about adding the Indianapolis team. Are we still talking 38 users total, or did that change?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It changed a little. We have 34 full users and 6 read-only, mostly operations managers who just need dashboards.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, that maps cleanly. Full users are $82 per seat per month, read-only are $24. With the annual term starting September 1, the total comes to $36,864 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I expected. On invoicing, can you do one invoice for the year, net 30? Our finance team does not want monthly bills for this.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, annual invoice, net 30 is standard. I can include PO number 4178 on the order form if that's still the right one.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, 4178. The other thing is go-live. We need the first calibration reports in there by October 14. Is that realistic?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It is, assuming we get the equipment list by September 6. Onboarding would be two working sessions the week of September 9, then validation on the 23rd. You'd be live before October 14.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Contract term is just 12 months, right? No auto-renewal longer than that?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, 12 months, September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027. It renews for another 12 months unless either side gives 45 days' notice. I’ll put that plainly in the summary.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Send it over today if you can. If legal doesn't have comments, I can sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll get the order form with the seat split, annual invoice terms, PO 4178, and the October 14 go-live target. Anything else you want included?
